AddQuoteForTwitch.description: Saves a new quote said by a Twitch user, given by their user id. Set captureGame to true to also save the game you are playing.
AddQuoteForTwitch.returns: The new quote's number, or -1 when the quote is empty.
AddQuoteForTwitch.example:
int id = CPH.AddQuoteForTwitch("123456789", "I meant to do that!", true);
CPH.SendMessage($"Saved quote #{id}");

AddQuoteForYouTube.description: Saves a new quote said by a YouTube user, given by their user (channel) id. The game is not saved.
AddQuoteForYouTube.returns: The new quote's number, or -1 when the quote is empty.
AddQuoteForYouTube.example:
int id = CPH.AddQuoteForYouTube("UCabc123", "Best stream ever!");
CPH.LogInfo($"Saved quote #{id}");

AddQuoteForKick.description: Saves a new quote said by a Kick user, given by their user id. Set captureGame to true to also save the game you are playing.
AddQuoteForKick.returns: The new quote's number, or -1 when the quote is empty.
AddQuoteForKick.example:
int id = CPH.AddQuoteForKick("987654", "Never pet a creeper.");
CPH.LogInfo($"Saved quote #{id}");

GetQuote.description: Finds a saved quote by its number, with who said it, when and during which game.
GetQuote.returns: The quote, or null (nothing) when there is no quote with that number.
GetQuote.example:
var quote = CPH.GetQuote(3);
if (quote != null) CPH.SendMessage($"#{quote.Id}: {quote.Quote} - {quote.User}");

GetQuoteCount.description: Counts how many quotes you have saved.
GetQuoteCount.example:
int count = CPH.GetQuoteCount();
CPH.SendMessage($"We have {count} quotes!");

DeleteQuote.description: Deletes a saved quote by its number.
DeleteQuote.returns: true when it was deleted, false when there is no quote with that number.

GetPoints.description: Reads how many points a viewer has. Give the points type (empty for your main points), the viewer's name, and the platform like "twitch" (empty uses the platform of the event).
GetPoints.returns: The viewer's points, or 0 when the viewer or points type is unknown.
GetPoints.example:
long points = CPH.GetPoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch");
CPH.SendMessage($"CoolViewer has {points} points");

AddPoints.description: Gives a viewer points. Set applyMultipliers to true to multiply the amount by their bonus (multiplier). The viewer must have chatted or have points already.
AddPoints.returns: The viewer's new total, or 0 when the viewer is unknown.

UpdatePoints.description: Changes a viewer's points by an amount: a positive number adds, a negative number takes away. Works the same as AddPoints.
UpdatePoints.returns: The viewer's new total, or 0 when the viewer is unknown.

UpdateBulkPoints.description: Changes the points of every viewer in a list by the same amount: a positive number adds, a negative number takes away. Unknown viewers are skipped.

SetPoints.description: Sets a viewer's points to an exact number.
SetPoints.returns: The viewer's new total, or 0 when the viewer is unknown.
SetPoints.example:
long total = CPH.SetPoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch", 1000);
CPH.LogInfo($"Points set to {total}");

SpendPoints.description: Takes points from a viewer, but only when they have enough. Handy for a reward that costs points.
SpendPoints.returns: true when the points were taken, false when the viewer has too few or is unknown (nothing is taken).
SpendPoints.example:
bool paid = CPH.SpendPoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch", 500);
if (paid) CPH.SendMessage("Enjoy your reward!");

RemovePoints.description: Deletes a viewer's points of one points type completely.
RemovePoints.returns: true when they were deleted, false when the viewer had none or is unknown.

ResetUserPoints.description: Sets a viewer's points back to 0.

TransferPoints.description: Moves points from one viewer to another. Leave the second platform empty to use the first one.
TransferPoints.returns: true when the points were moved, false when the giver has too few or either viewer is unknown.

AwardPointsToAll.description: Gives points to every viewer Cuebot knows, or only those on one platform. Set onlyActive to true to give them only to viewers who are in chat right now.
AwardPointsToAll.example:
int paid = CPH.AwardPointsToAll("", 50, "twitch");
CPH.SendMessage($"{paid} viewers got 50 points!");

AwardPointsToGroup.description: Gives points to every member of a user group.
AwardPointsToGroup.example:
int paid = CPH.AwardPointsToGroup("", "Raid Team", 100);
CPH.LogInfo($"Paid {paid} members");

GetGroupMultiplier.description: Reads a user group's points bonus (multiplier). 2 means members earn double.
GetGroupMultiplier.returns: The multiplier, or 1 when the group has none.
GetGroupMultiplier.example:
double bonus = CPH.GetGroupMultiplier("", "Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"Regulars earn x{bonus}");

SetGroupMultiplier.description: Sets a user group's points bonus (multiplier). 2 means members earn double.

RemoveGroupMultiplier.description: Removes a user group's points bonus, so its members earn the normal amount.

GetUserMultiplier.description: Reads a viewer's total points bonus (multiplier), from their own bonus, their groups and their roles (like sub or VIP).
GetUserMultiplier.returns: The multiplier, or 1 when no bonus applies.
GetUserMultiplier.example:
double bonus = CPH.GetUserMultiplier("", "CoolViewer", "twitch");
CPH.LogInfo($"CoolViewer earns x{bonus}");

GetLeaderboard.description: Gets the viewers with the most points. count is how many (0 or less gives everyone); offset skips that many from the top first.
GetLeaderboard.returns: A list of places, each with rank, platform, user name, user id and points.
GetLeaderboard.example:
var top = CPH.GetLeaderboard("", 3);
foreach (var entry in top) CPH.SendMessage($"#{entry.Rank} {entry.UserName}: {entry.Points}");

GetPointDefinition.description: Gets the settings of a points type by its name (empty for your main points): its names, symbol, highest allowed balance and whether it only counts while live.
GetPointDefinition.returns: The points type, or null (nothing) when there is none with that name.
GetPointDefinition.example:
var coins = CPH.GetPointDefinition("Coins");
if (coins != null) CPH.LogInfo($"{coins.Name} enabled: {coins.Enabled}");

GetPointDefinitions.description: Lists all your points types, your main one first.
GetPointDefinitions.example:
var types = CPH.GetPointDefinitions();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {types.Count} points type(s)");

ResetPointDefinition.description: Sets every viewer's points of one points type back to 0. Careful: this cannot be undone.

ResetCredits.description: Clears the end-of-stream credits collected so far (followers, subs, raiders and so on).

ResetFirstWords.description: Forgets who has chatted, on every platform, so everyone's next message runs the First Words trigger again.

PronounLookup.description: Looks up a Twitch user's pronouns from alejo.io (pronouns.alejo.io), by their login name.
PronounLookup.returns: A list of named values (hasPronouns, pronoun, pronounSubject, pronounObject and more), or null (nothing) when the name is empty or the lookup failed.
PronounLookup.example:
var p = CPH.PronounLookup("CoolViewer");
if (p != null) CPH.LogInfo("Pronouns: " + p["pronoun"]);

PronounClearForUserlogin.description: Forgets saved pronouns so the next lookup asks alejo.io again. Cuebot clears them for every user, not just the one you name.

ShowToastNotification.description: Shows a pop-up notification on your computer. An attribution text is added under the message. The form with an id first gives that id as the toastId variable when the pop-up is clicked.

PlaySoundFromFolder.description: Plays a random sound file (wav, mp3, ogg, flac) from a folder. Volume is 0.0 to 1.0. Set recursive to look in folders inside it too; set finishBeforeContinuing to wait until it ends.
PlaySoundFromFolder.returns: How long the sound is, in seconds, or 0 when the folder has no sounds.
PlaySoundFromFolder.example:
double seconds = CPH.PlaySoundFromFolder("C:/Stream/Sounds/Hype", 0.8f);
CPH.LogInfo($"Playing a {seconds} second sound");

DeckItemSetBackground.description: Changes the background colour or picture of a button on one of your Decks. Decks and buttons are found by id or name. fileId works as a picture link or file path. state picks the button state (0 is normal).

DeckItemSetIcon.description: Changes the icon of a button on one of your Decks: its colour, icon name, or a picture link (fileId works as a picture link or path too). state picks the button state (0 is normal).

DeckItemSetState.description: Switches a button on one of your Decks to another state. States count from 0 (the normal state).

DeckItemSetTitle.description: Changes the words on a button on one of your Decks, and optionally their colour. state picks the button state (0 is normal).

DeckItemSetValue.description: Sets the number shown on a button on one of your Decks, like a death counter. state picks the button state (0 is normal).

DeckItemToggleState.description: Switches a button on one of your Decks between state 0 and state 1, like an on/off switch.

DeckNotify.description: Shows a message with a title on one of your Decks. Cuebot's Deck messages have no colour or sound, so those are ignored.

DeckPageNext.description: Moves one of your Decks to its next page. After the last page it starts again at the first.

DeckPagePrev.description: Moves one of your Decks to its previous page. Before the first page it goes to the last.

DeckPageSet.description: Shows a page of one of your Decks by number, counting from 1 like the Decks editor.
